scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I trust that you are enjoying
life as a Super Novice? Ah,
good good...just as I expected.
Verily, the light of mediocrity is shining brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我相信你正享受着作为超级初心者的生活？啊，很好很好...正如我所料。
确实，平庸的光辉正在你体内闪耀...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to live
life as Mister Kimu-Shaun did...
Become a Jack of All Trades...
...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我鼓励你像金穆·尚先生那样生活...
成为一个样样通...
...却样样不精的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Ah, you've brought the
items I've requested!
You've proven yourself
worthy of joining our
Super Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
啊，你带来了
我要求的物品！
你已证明了自己
有资格加入我们的
超级初心者协会。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Then, as promised, I will
change your job into a
^3355FFSuper Novi--^000000Huh?
What's that behind you?
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
那么，如我所承诺的，我将
把你的职业转换为
^3355FF超级初--^000000咦？
你身后是什么？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou look behind you, but...
There's nothing's there.
Something fishy is going on here!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回头看了看，但...
那里什么都没有。
这里肯定有什么不对劲！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Bwaha! I got you!
So...how do you like my joke?
Oh well, let's forget that...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
哈哈！我骗到你了！
那么...你觉得我的笑话怎么样？
算了，就当作没发生过吧...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As well as any possible
reason a grown man such as
myself would carry around
a pair of Panties.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
以及像我这样的大人
为什么会随身携带
一条内裤的任何可能理由。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The important thing is...
you have joined the esteemed
ranks of the great Super Novices.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
重要的是...
你已经加入了伟大的
超级初心者们的尊贵行列。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Consider these Panties a gift...
This very garment is rumored
to be worn by Mister Kimu-Shaun,
our legendary club founder, in
his early days in striving for
exemplary mediocrity.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
请把这些内裤当作礼物...
据说这件衣物
曾由我们传奇的俱乐部创始人
金穆·尚先生
在他追求极致平庸的
早期岁月里穿着。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Go out, and enjoy your new life
as a Super Novice! Venture
forth and help the common
man, while being one at at
the same time!
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
去吧，享受你作为
超级初心者的新生活！
向前迈进，帮助普通人，
同时自己也要做一个普通人！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Huh? Did you forget what I
wanted from you? Okay,
I will let you know once
again. Please remember
this time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
咦？你忘了我
想要什么了吗？好吧，
我再告诉你一次。
请这次记住...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I asked you to bring me
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000 and
^FF000030 Resin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我让你给我带
^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000和
^FF000030个树脂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...Hmm?
Stop.
Let me look at you.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
...嗯？
停下。
让我看看你。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I see that the light
of mediocrity shines
brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我看到平庸的光辉
正在你体内
闪耀...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Why don't you join us,
young Novice? Join
us and learn the subtle
greatness of being
mediocre...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
何不加入我们，
年轻的初心者？加入
我们，学习平庸
那微妙而伟大的
真谛...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Accept my offer...
Cast off your those
brown, dusty garments
and bloom into...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
接受我的提议...
脱下你那
棕色、沾满灰尘的衣物，
绽放成为...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...a ^CE6300Super Novice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
...一位 ^CE6300超级初心者^000000。

scripts.text: Accept his offer.
scripts.translation: 接受他的提议

scripts.text: Reject his offer.
scripts.translation: 拒绝他的提议

scripts.text: Listen more carefully.
scripts.translation: 仔细聆听

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
appreciate the value of
finding strength in
weakness? You must
prove to me that you
are a true underachiever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...但你是否真正理解在软弱中寻求力量的价值？
你必须向我证明，你是一名真正的平庸者。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life as a Novice...
And return when you
have mastered the
Basic Skills...
Grow in mediocrity and
Become a Level 10 Novice...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
像初心者一样生活...
当你掌握了基本技能后再回来...
在平庸中成长，
成为一名10级的初心者...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
value the relaxed lifestyle
of the banal adventurer?
Prove to me that you do not
lust for power...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...但你是否真正珍视平凡冒险者那种悠闲的生活方式？
向我证明，你并不渴望权力...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life mundanely...
Become a Level 45 Novice...
It will be then that you can join us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
平凡地生活...
成为一名45级的初心者...
到那时，你才能加入我们...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I can see in your eyes
the determination to
live life simply...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我能从你的眼中看到
简单生活的决心...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Only the truly wise can
see that being ordinary
and banal is the best
way to live life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
只有真正智慧的人
才能明白，平凡和庸常
才是生活的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
However, we do not welcome
just anyone into our society.
You must first pass our
qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
然而，我们并不欢迎任何人加入我们的组织。
你必须先通过我们的资格测试。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
For this test, you must
bring me some items which
are dropped from normal,
unexceptional monsters.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
为了这次测试，
你需要带给我一些
由普通、平庸的魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmmm...
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000
and ^FF000030 Resin
^000000will be suitable to test your
ability to fight meager enemies.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...
^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000
和^FF00003030个树脂^000000
将适合测试你
与弱小敌人战斗的能力。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Also, the number 30
is significant. It's not
anything special...just
an ordinary number.
Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
此外，数字30很有意义。
它没什么特别的...
只是一个普通的数字。
哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
祝你好运，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well, well...I suppose the
value of the simple life
is difficult for you to
to grasp. It's...okay...
Your life is your own.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
哎呀...我想你很难理解
简单生活的价值。
没...没关系...
你的生活由你自己做主。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
But, if you ever see the
light of banality, you
are welcome to visit me
anytime...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
但是，如果你有一天
看到了平庸的光辉，
欢迎随时来找我...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As our Novice club
grows more popular and
we gain more followers,
we may consider using
a more difficult test...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
随着我们的初心者社团
越来越受欢迎，
信徒越来越多，
我们可能会考虑
使用更难的测试...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Our Novice Society was founded
by the legendary Mister
Kimu-Shaun...perhaps the
greatest man in our generation.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们的初心者社团
是由传奇人物
金姆·肖恩创立的...
他或许是我们这一代
最伟大的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He realized that there
was much suffering in the
world, especially among
the common people of
Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他意识到世界上
充满了苦难，
尤其是米德加尔特
的普通百姓...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He learned many skills from
all the different people he
met...but since he didn't
stay in one place for long,
he became a jack of all
trades...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他从遇到的各种人那里
学到了许多技能...
但他没有在一个地方停留太久，
因此他成为了
样样通...
却样样不精的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
In sharing the pain of
the common man, he became
became one himself...
the greatest ordinary
man ever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
在与普通人分担痛苦的过程中，
他自己也变成了普通人...
成为了有史以来最伟大的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The members of our society
try to live as Mister
Kimu-Shaun did, according to
the principles he laid before us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们社团的成员
努力像金姆·肖恩先生那样生活，
遵循他为我们制定的原则...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
How do you like living
life simply as a Super
Novice? I'm sure that
you're enjoying it~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
作为超级初心者，
过着简单的生活感觉如何？
我相信你肯定很享受~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Please grow as a Super
Novice by helping the
common man while being
one at the same time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
请在保持普通人的同时，
帮助他人，
以此成长为一名超级初心者...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to
grow in your Super
Noviceness, and lead
an example in living
an exceptionally
mundane life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我鼓励你
提升你的“超级初心者”境界，
并以身作则，
过上极其平凡的生活。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hello, I am Tzerero,
the unofficial executive
director of the Great
Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
你好，我是泽雷罗，
伟大初心者社团的
非官方执行总监。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmm...you seem to be well
above the average person.
Yes, you're definitely more
'extraordinary' than you are
'ordinary...'
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...你似乎比
普通人强得多。
是的，你绝对是
“非凡”多于“平凡”...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
*Sigh* I suppose you
could never understand
our way of life, the
subtle greatness in
being ordinary. But
that's alright.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
*叹气* 我想你
永远无法理解
我们的生活方式，
那种身为普通人的微妙伟大。
不过没关系。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well...there are thousands
of different people in this
world, so I just try to accept
all of our differences.
I hope you will too.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...这个世界上
有成千上万不同的人，
所以我试着接受
我们所有的差异。
希望你也如此。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You! Stronger than before.
I knew you could pass the test~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你！比以前更强了。
我就知道你能通过测试~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hm? Hey, you're a member
of our great Novice Society,
aren't you? Isn't this the
best club ever?!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嗯？嘿，你是
我们伟大初心者社团的成员，
对吧？这难道不是
有史以来最棒的社团吗？！

scripts.text:
[Essaray]
Living life mundanely,
according to the principles
of Mister Kimu-Shaun...
It's great to be ordinary!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
按照金姆·肖恩先生的原则，
平凡地生活...
身为普通人真是太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Let's try to lead our lives
as normally as we can!
For your reference, I am
the number one member,
under Mister Tzerero of
course!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
让我们尽量
正常地生活吧！
供你参考，我是
第一号成员，
当然是在泽雷罗先生之下！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hah~ you don't know anything
about being a normal person yet!
Why don't you join our Novice
Society? This club is the best in the world~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哈~你还不知道
做普通人的滋味呢！
何不加入我们的初心者社团？
这个社团是世界上最好的~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Yup, Super Novices
are the best characters!
Hahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
没错，超级初心者
是最棒的角色！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Bah~! You're better than
average...Hell, you may
even be 'special.'
What a shame! Well...
I hope you still live
your life positively.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嘁~！你比一般人强...
天哪，你甚至可能是“特别”的。
真遗憾！好吧...
我希望你依然
积极地生活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Mister Super Novice~
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你好，超级初心者先生~
其他卡普拉 职员
不让你租用手推车，
你一定很失望吧。
但现在别担心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Super Novice, Ma'am.
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
你好，超级初心者女士。
其他卡普拉 职员
不让你租用手推车，
你一定很失望吧。
但现在别担心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm here to support you guys
by providing carts...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我在这里
通过提供手推车
来支持你们...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^3355FF*whispers*^000000
^555555I am not supposed to do this
because it's against our
company policy. But I felt
really sorry for Super Novices
...so here I am.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
^3355FF*小声说*^000000
^555555我不应该这样做，
因为这违反了公司政策。
但我真的很同情超级初心者
...所以我来了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, would you like to rent a cart? The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
那么，您想租用手推车吗？
服务费是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, here's the thing...
Have you learned the 'Push Cart'
skill? I can just rent you a
cart, but if you haven't
learned to push it, you'll
just be wasting your zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦，是这样的...
您学会“手推车”技能了吗？
我可以直接租给您，
但如果您还没学会怎么推，
那就只是白白浪费Zeny了。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So make sure that you have
the 'Push Cart' skill already.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
所以请确保您已经
拥有“手推车”技能。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, you've already equipped a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦，您已经装备了手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using my service.
Although what I am doing might
not be legitimate to other
Kafra Employees, I strongly
believe I am doing what's right for the customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
感谢您使用我的服务。
虽然其他卡普拉 职员
可能认为我的做法不合规，
但我坚信这样做
才是对顾客最好的。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, but you do not have enough zeny with you. The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
服务费是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎再次光临。
感谢您使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎再次光临。
感谢您使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good da--Oops...!
I don't think I can provide you
with the services you want...
Please go talk to another
Kafra employee. I apologize
for such inconvenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
好...哎呀！
我想我无法为您提供
您想要的服务...
请去找其他卡普拉 职员。
给您带来不便，我很抱歉...
